<wms:deegreeWMS xmlns:wms="http://www.deegree.org/services/wms"
                xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.deegree.org/services/wms https://schemas.deegree.org/core/3.5/services/wms/wms_configuration.xsd">

  <wms:ServiceConfiguration>
    <wms:DefaultLayerOptions>
      <wms:FeatureInfoRadius>10</wms:FeatureInfoRadius>
    </wms:DefaultLayerOptions>
    <wms:ThemeId>vektor</wms:ThemeId>
    <wms:ThemeId>bplanraster</wms:ThemeId>
    <wms:ThemeId>fplanraster</wms:ThemeId>
    <wms:ThemeId>lplanraster</wms:ThemeId>
    <wms:ThemeId>rplanraster</wms:ThemeId>
    <wms:ThemeId>soplanraster</wms:ThemeId>
  </wms:ServiceConfiguration>
  <wms:FeatureInfoFormats>
    <wms:GetFeatureInfoFormat>
      <wms:File>html.gfi</wms:File>
      <wms:Format>text/html</wms:Format>
    </wms:GetFeatureInfoFormat>
    <wms:GetFeatureInfoFormat>
      <wms:GeoJSON allowOtherCrsThanWGS84="true" allowExportOfGeometries="true" />
      <wms:Format>application/geo+json</wms:Format>
    </wms:GetFeatureInfoFormat>
  </wms:FeatureInfoFormats>
  <wms:MaxWidth>3840</wms:MaxWidth>
  <wms:MaxHeight>2160</wms:MaxHeight>
</wms:deegreeWMS>
==== webapp context path in WARs ====
['META-INF/', 'META-INF/MANIFEST.MF', 'META-INF/maven/', 'META-INF/maven/de.latlon.deegree/', 'META-INF/maven/de.latlon.deegree/deegree-webservices-basic/', 'images/', 'WEB-INF/', 'WEB-INF/lib/']

observation.command: cat /opt/deegree/xplan-services-wms-workspace/services/wms.xml; echo "==== webapp context path in WARs ===="; python3 -c "import zipfile; print(zipfile.ZipFile('/tmp/dist/web/xplan-services-wms.war').namelist()[:8])"
